text:
Today we're heading back to the parliament for the third and final discussion on the gradual process at the Immigration Committee.

This is our final push before the Knesset is dissolved, and we hope the discussion will lead to concrete conclusions and meaningful policy changes. After demonstrating to the committee that the waiting times during the first stage of the process are unreasonable, our focus today will be on shortening the B1 period for unmarried couples, promoting a more efficient and streamlined process through Israeli embassies abroad, and eliminating or significantly limiting the requirement to undergo the Nativ process.

While PIBA has remained uncooperative, the fact that these issues have been brought to the Knesset and discussed in three dedicated committee meetings is, in itself, a significant achievement for our community. For years, these challenges received little public attention. Today, they are being examined at the highest levels, with policymakers, government officials, and public representatives hearing directly about the realities faced by international couples.

We'll keep you updated on the outcomes of the discussion.

צילום: דוברות הכנסת
